name: Customer Segment Service Analysis
query:
SELECT 
    service_name as "Service",
    SUM(CASE WHEN quotation_to = 'Business' THEN grand_total ELSE 0 END) as "Business Revenue",
    SUM(CASE WHEN quotation_to = 'Personnel' THEN grand_total ELSE 0 END) as "Personnel Revenue",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN quotation_to = 'Business' THEN 1 END) as "Business Count",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN quotation_to = 'Personnel' THEN 1 END) as "Personnel Count"
FROM 
    `tabService Estimate`
WHERE 
    status NOT IN ('Open', 'Cancelled')
    AND service_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    service_name
ORDER BY 
    "Business Revenue" + "Personnel Revenue" DESC
